messages.content:
Let \( a_0, a_1, a_2, \ldots \) be the unique sequence of nonnegative integers less than 397 with \( a_0 = 1 \) and

\[ a_{n+1}(a_n + 1)^2 \equiv a_n \pmod{397} \]

for all nonnegative integers \( n \). Given that \( a_{2026} = 9 \), compute the remainder when \( a_0 + a_1 + \cdots + a_{2026} \) is divided by 397.

Put your final answer within \boxed{}.

message.content:
We work modulo \(397\). Since \(397\) is prime, we may use reciprocals.

Let

\[
b_n \equiv a_n^{-1} \pmod{397}.
\]

The recurrence gives

\[
a_{n+1} \equiv a_n(a_n+1)^{-2} \pmod{397},
\]

so taking reciprocals,

\[
b_{n+1} \equiv (a_n+1)^2 a_n^{-1}
= a_n+2+b_n \pmod{397}.
\]

Thus

\[
a_n \equiv b_{n+1}-b_n-2 \pmod{397}.
\]

Summing from \(n=0\) to \(2026\),

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{2026} a_n
\equiv b_{2027}-b_0-2\cdot 2027 \pmod{397}.
\]

Now \(a_0=1\), so \(b_0=1\). Given \(a_{2026}=9\),

\[
b_{2026}\equiv 9^{-1}\pmod{397}.
\]

Since \(9\cdot 44=396\equiv -1\pmod{397}\), we have

\[
9^{-1}\equiv -44\equiv 353\pmod{397}.
\]

Then

\[
b_{2027}\equiv b_{2026}+a_{2026}+2
\equiv 353+9+2
\equiv 364\pmod{397}.
\]

Also,

\[
2\cdot 2027=4054\equiv 84\pmod{397}.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\sum_{n=0}^{2026} a_n
\equiv 364-1-84
\equiv 279\pmod{397}.
\]

\[
\boxed{279}
\]
